headline: Meet Clara Schoonover, L.M.T.
intro: Skilled, caring, and dedicated to helping every client feel their best — inside and out.
paragraphs: Clara Schoonover is a licensed massage therapist and cosmetologist serving Chickasha with thoughtful, results-focused care. Her work is rooted in helping clients feel more comfortable in their bodies and more confident in their daily routine.

After completing her massage therapy training through Platt College, Clara built a practice centered on therapeutic massage, soft tissue work, orthopedic support, reflexology, and other evidence-informed approaches that help with pain relief, recovery, and stress reduction.

She is also a member of the Associated Bodywork & Massage Professionals (ABMP) and has additional training in breast massage, cupping, myofascial release, craniosacral therapy, ear candling, aromatherapy, and waxing/sugaring. Every session is shaped around your goals—whether you need stress relief, pain management, better mobility, or simply a chance to reset.
